00104                                 _smatrix_insert( mat_in, i_in, j_in, -1, val_in );
00105                         else

00107                         mat_in->nvals = mat_in->nvals + 1;
00108                 }

00213 int smatrix_load( smatrix_t *mat_in, char *fn_in )
00214 {
00215         std::ifstream fp;
00216         fp.open( fn_in, std::ios::in | std::ios::binary );
00217         if( fp.fail() )
00218                 return -1;
00219         long int i,j,r,cols,rows,vals,tmp;
00220         char ndp;
00221         fp.read( (char*) &ndp, 1 );
00222         assert( ndp == (char) 0xff );                                           // ndp = 0xff asserts that this is a sparse matrix binary
00223         fp.read( (char*) &vals, sizeof(long int) );
00224         fp.read( (char*) &rows, sizeof(long int) );
00225         fp.read( (char*) &cols, sizeof(long int) );
00226         if( vals < 0 || rows < 0 || cols < 0 )
00227                 return -2;
00228         smatrix_init( mat_in, rows, cols );
00229         while( true )
00230         {
00231                 fp.read( (char*) &r, sizeof(long int) );                        // Read the current row number
00232                 if( r < 0 || r >= rows )
00233                         return -3;                                              // Return value of -1 from smatrix_load indicates an index out of range
00234                 fp.read( (char*) ( mat_in->lvec + r ), sizeof(long int) );      // Read the number of non-zero entries in row r
00235                 if( mat_in->lvec[r] < 0 || mat_in->lvec[r] >= cols )
00236                         return -3;                                              // Ditto here
00237                 mat_in->mvec[r] = (double*) malloc( ( mat_in->lvec[r] + 1 ) * sizeof(double) );
00238                 if( mat_in->mvec[r] == NULL )                                   // This is a bad error which mean
00239                         return -4;                                              // that could not allocate memory
00240                 mat_in->jvec[r] = (long int*) malloc( ( mat_in->lvec[r] + 1 ) * sizeof(long int) );
00241                 if( mat_in->jvec[r] == NULL )
00242                         return -4;
00243                 for(j=0;j<mat_in->lvec[r];j++)
00244                 {
00245                         fp.read( (char*) ( mat_in->jvec[r] + j ), sizeof(long int) );
00246                         fp.read( (char*) ( mat_in->mvec[r] + j ), sizeof(double) );
00247                         mat_in->nvals = mat_in->nvals + 1;
00248                 }
00249                 if( mat_in->nvals >= vals )                                     // Should never have mat_in->nvals > vals, ever
00250                         break;
00251         }
00252         fp.close();
00253         assert( mat_in->nvals == vals );                                        // Just in case
00254         return 0;
00255 }

00261 int smatrix_save( smatrix_t *mat_in, char *fn_in )
00262 {
00263         std::ofstream fp;
00264         fp.open( fn_in, std::ios::out | std::ios::binary );
00265         if( fp.fail() )
00266                 return -1;
00267         long int i,j;
00268         char ndp = 0xff;
00269         fp.write( (char*) &ndp, 1 ); // Write 0xFF as the dimensional parameter, similar in _dsvmat/_dldmat and vec counterparts
00270         fp.write( (char*) &mat_in->nvals, sizeof(long int) ); // Write the number of entries, cast as long int (usually 8 bytes)
00271         fp.write( (char*) &mat_in->nrows, sizeof(long int) ); // Write the number of rows
00272         fp.write( (char*) &mat_in->ncols, sizeof(long int) ); // Write the number of columns
00273         for(i=0;i<mat_in->nrows;i++)
00274         {
00275                 if( mat_in->lvec[i] <= 0 )                              /* Only write row to file if it has non-zero entries    */
00276                         continue;
00277                 fp.write( (char*) &i, sizeof(long int) );               /* Write the row number                                 */
00278                 fp.write( (char*) &mat_in->lvec[i], sizeof(long int) ); /* Write the row length                                 */
00279                 for(j=0;j<mat_in->lvec[i];j++)
00280                 {
00281                         fp.write( (char*) &mat_in->jvec[i][j], sizeof(long int) );
00282                         fp.write( (char*) &mat_in->mvec[i][j], sizeof(double) );
00283                 }
00284         }
00285         fp.close();
00286         return 0;
00287 }

00336 void smatrix_shift( smatrix_t *mat_in, double shift_in )
00337 {
